decomposition_rationale: Strategic engagement decomposed along three primary issue tree branches: (1) Market sizing and demand drivers, (2) Competitive landscape and technology assessment, (3) Strategic positioning and risk analysis. DAG structure reflects natural dependencies: market sizing informs competitive share estimates, and both inform strategic assessment.

tasks.description: Estimate total addressable market for automotive-grade lidar 2025-2030, disaggregated by autonomy level (L2+, L3, L4+) and geography (NA, EU, China)
acceptance_criteria: Top-down and bottom-up estimates with explicit assumptions
At least 3 independent data sources with URLs and access dates
Uncertainty range quantified with sensitivity to key assumptions
Disaggregation by autonomy level AND geography
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate the size and growth trajectory of the automotive lidar market, including evidence for both faster-than-expected adoption (regulatory mandates, OEM commitments) and slower-than-expected adoption (camera-only viability, cost barriers, regulatory delays)
tasks.end_product: Market size table with TAM/SAM/SOM breakdown by autonomy level, growth rate chart (2025-2030), sensitivity analysis on 3 key assumptions (L4 timeline, ASP decline curve, China adoption rate)

tasks.description: Compare 1550nm vs 905nm lidar technology approaches and camera-only/radar alternatives on performance, cost trajectory, and manufacturing readiness
acceptance_criteria: Technical comparison across at least 5 dimensions (range, resolution, cost, manufacturing complexity, eye safety)
Patent landscape analysis with key IP holders identified
Manufacturing readiness assessment for each approach
Expert/OEM perspectives on technology convergence timeline
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of each sensing approach including evidence that challenges the assumption that lidar is necessary for L4+ autonomy
tasks.end_product: Technology comparison matrix (5+ dimensions x 4+ approaches), patent landscape summary, manufacturing readiness scorecard

tasks.description: Map the competitive landscape: top 10 lidar companies by market share, technology approach, OEM relationships, and financial position
acceptance_criteria: Top 10 competitors identified with defensible market share estimates
Categorized by technology approach and target autonomy level
OEM partnership/design-win inventory per competitor
Financial health assessment (cash runway, revenue trajectory, margin profile)
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Map the competitive landscape including evidence that challenges Luminar's perceived market leadership position and highlights competitors with underappreciated advantages
tasks.end_product: Competitive positioning matrix (2x2: technology maturity vs market access), per-player profile table, OEM relationship map

tasks.description: Analyze Luminar's unit economics vs key competitors at projected 2027 production volumes. Focus on BOM cost, ASP trajectory, and gross margin path.
acceptance_criteria: BOM cost estimates for Luminar Iris vs competitor products
ASP trajectory comparison (2024 actual to 2027 projected)
Gross margin path to profitability assessment
Sensitivity analysis on volume assumptions
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate Luminar's path to unit economics profitability including evidence for both faster (volume ramp, design wins) and slower (yield issues, pricing pressure, delayed OEM programs) scenarios
tasks.end_product: Unit economics comparison table (Luminar vs top 3 competitors), gross margin bridge chart (2024-2027), volume sensitivity analysis

tasks.description: Deep dive on Chinese lidar competitors (Hesai, RoboSense, Livox/DJI): technology maturity, cost position, export capability, and Western OEM traction
acceptance_criteria: Individual profiles for top 3 Chinese competitors
Cost advantage quantification vs Western lidar companies
Assessment of technology gap (narrowing or stable)
Western OEM design win pipeline for Chinese suppliers
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate the competitive threat from Chinese lidar companies including evidence both for rapid gap closure and for persistent disadvantages in quality, certification, or OEM trust
tasks.end_product: Per-competitor profile table (technology, cost, OEM wins, regulatory status), competitive threat assessment matrix

tasks.description: Assess camera-only perception system viability for L4 autonomy: Tesla FSD progress, Mobileye SuperVision/EyeQ Ultra, academic research on sensor fusion vs camera-only
acceptance_criteria: Current performance benchmarks for camera-only vs lidar-equipped systems
Regulatory pathway analysis for camera-only L4 certification
Expert consensus assessment on camera-only viability timeline
Implications for lidar TAM if camera-only achieves L4
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate the viability of camera-only approaches for L4 autonomy including evidence both for near-term breakthroughs and for fundamental physical limitations that require lidar
tasks.end_product: Camera-only vs lidar performance comparison table, regulatory pathway timeline, TAM sensitivity to camera-only scenario

tasks.description: Map regulatory landscape for AV sensor requirements across key markets (US, EU, China). Identify any mandates or standards that favor or disfavor lidar.
acceptance_criteria: Regulatory status in 3 key markets (US, EU, China)
Pending standards or mandates affecting sensor requirements
Timeline for regulatory clarity on L3/L4 sensor requirements
Assessment of regulatory bias toward or against specific sensor types
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate the regulatory landscape including evidence for both lidar-favorable mandates and technology-neutral regulations that could undermine the case for dedicated lidar hardware
tasks.end_product: Regulatory comparison table (US/EU/China), pending regulation timeline, regulatory risk assessment matrix

tasks.description: Assess Luminar's OEM design wins, partnership depth, and switching cost analysis. How locked in are Volvo, Mercedes, and other announced partners?
acceptance_criteria: Complete inventory of announced OEM partnerships with contract details where available
Switching cost assessment per partnership (technical integration depth, timeline commitments)
Historical OEM lidar supplier switching patterns
Assessment of partnership durability under competitive pricing pressure
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate the durability of Luminar's OEM partnerships including evidence for both high switching costs (deep integration, certification sunk costs) and low switching costs (modular interfaces, competitive pressure, OEM dual-sourcing)
tasks.end_product: OEM partnership inventory table, switching cost scorecard per partner, partnership durability assessment

tasks.description: Synthesize findings into scenario analysis: bull/base/bear cases for Luminar's competitive position through 2028, with key drivers and signposts for each scenario
acceptance_criteria: Three coherent scenarios (bull/base/bear) with explicit assumptions
Key branching factors identified with leading indicators
Revenue and market share implications per scenario
Risk factors ranked by probability and impact
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Construct scenarios that steel-man both the bull and bear cases rather than anchoring to the base case, including genuinely challenging evidence for each scenario
tasks.end_product: Three-scenario comparison table (assumptions, revenue impact, market share), key signpost monitoring dashboard, risk heat map (probability x impact)

tasks.description: Historical analogy analysis: identify 2-3 technology transitions with structural similarities to the lidar market (e.g., HDD to SSD, plasma to LCD, GPS commoditization) and extract lessons for timing, moat durability, and winner profiles
acceptance_criteria: At least 2 historical analogies with explicit structural mapping to lidar market
Assessment of where each analogy breaks down
Lessons extracted for competitive position durability, timing, and market structure
Application to Luminar's specific position
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Identify historical analogies that illuminate both favorable and unfavorable outcomes for incumbent technology leaders during sensor/component transitions
tasks.end_product: Analogy comparison table (structural parallels, divergences, lessons), application matrix mapping lessons to Luminar's position
